verse.verse_1: By the winds (or angels or the Messengers of Allah) sent forth one after another.
verse.verse_2: And by the winds that blow violently,
verse.verse_3: And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain;
verse.verse_4: And by the Verses (of the Quran) that separate the right from the wrong.
verse.verse_5: And by the angels that bring the revelations to the Messengers,
verse.verse_6: To cut off all excuses or to warn;
verse.verse_7: Surely, what you are promised must come to pass.
verse.verse_8: Then when the stars lose their lights;
verse.verse_9: And when the heaven is cleft asunder;
verse.verse_10: And when the mountains are blown away;
verse.verse_11: And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed;
verse.verse_12: For what Day are these signs postponed?
verse.verse_13: For the Day of sorting out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell).
verse.verse_14: And what will explain to you what is the Day of sorting out?
verse.verse_15: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_16: Did We not destroy the ancients?
verse.verse_17: So shall We make later generations to follow them.
verse.verse_18: Thus do We deal with the Mujrimun (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals, etc.)!
verse.verse_19: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_20: Did We not create you from a worthless water (semen, etc.)?
verse.verse_21: Then We placed it in a place of safety (womb),
verse.verse_22: For a known period (determined by gestation)?
verse.verse_23: So We did measure, and We are the Best to measure (the things).
verse.verse_24: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_25: Have We not made the earth a receptacle?
verse.verse_26: For the living and the dead.
verse.verse_27: And have placed therein firm, and tall mountains; and have given you to drink sweet water?
verse.verse_28: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_29: (It will be said to the disbelievers): "Depart you to that which you used to deny!
verse.verse_30: "Depart you to a shadow (of Hell-fire smoke ascending) in three columns,
verse.verse_31: "Neither shading, nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire."
verse.verse_32: Verily! It (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr [a fort or a Qasr (huge log of wood)],
verse.verse_33: As if they were Jimalatun Sufr (yellow camels or bundles of ropes)."
verse.verse_34: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_35: That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it),
verse.verse_36: And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse.
verse.verse_37: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_38: That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!
verse.verse_39: So if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allah)!
verse.verse_40: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_41: Verily, the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2) shall be amidst shades and springs.
verse.verse_42: And fruits, such as they desire.
verse.verse_43: "Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do.
verse.verse_44: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinun (good-doers).
verse.verse_45: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_46: (O you disbelievers)! Eat and enjoy yourselves (in this worldly life) for a little while. Verily, you are the Mujrimun (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals, etc.).
verse.verse_47: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_48: And when it is said to them: "Bow down yourself (in prayer)!" They bow not down (offer not their prayers).
verse.verse_49: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_50: Then in what statement after this (the Quran) will they believe?
